name: zeus-facilitator
description: Zeus-operated x402 v2 facilitator — canonical /verify + /settle for EIP-3009 (USDC) payments on networks the free public facilitators do not cover (X Layer eip155:196 first). Wire contract identical to the one enforced by the F-112 mocks: POST /settle {x402Version, paymentPayload, paymentRequirements} → {success, transaction, errorReason?}
